scope: Independent architectural source and appearance review of these exact artifacts. This is not mesh-manufacturability QA, full scene-state equivalence, structural assessment, or physical-print certification.

original_pngs.name: front
original_pngs.observation: Northeast overview: high frame with inward-sloping top return, deep east galleries, 5 south and 2 north sloped balconies plus lower terrace, open court, front raised glazing band and asymmetric northern lower entry retained.

original_pngs.name: rear
original_pngs.observation: Southwest rear overview: conservative unfenestrated west classroom mass and differing end cores retained; the previous display-only diagonal color artifacts are absent. Does not assert true western facade has no windows.

original_pngs.name: east
original_pngs.observation: Full east elevation: 5/2 asymmetric balcony cadence, sloping giant frame, raised front recessed long glazing, southern stair niche and northern upper screen/lower entry visible. Passage behind leftmost front bay retained despite the southern rear low-wing wall visible beyond.

original_pngs.name: west
original_pngs.observation: Full west elevation openly exposes the intentionally simplified back and limited ground through-passages; no invented copied east windows or undated equipment.

original_pngs.name: south
original_pngs.observation: Full south short side remains conservative where source views are tree-obscured; different south core and low wing are not mirrored from north. Visible rounded top-frame termination is a disclosed manufacture join, not a surveyed facade fitting.

original_pngs.name: north
original_pngs.observation: Full north short side shows tall narrow slot with floor-edge crossings, different deeper northern core, and front low wing; occluded rear detail remains plain. Rounded terminal top-frame join is a manufacture simplification.

original_pngs.name: top
original_pngs.observation: Top view preserves high-strip roof, unequal end cores, deep front frame return, southern and northern low wings and open-to-sky central court. The simple roof intentionally excludes undated PV/equipment and is not a surveyed roof plan.

original_pngs.name: courtyard-gallery
original_pngs.observation: Deliberate perspective detail of inner east gallery: corridor depth, real openings, thickened guard bands, columns, rear recessed opaque glazing and offset sloping balconies remain legible. No near-plane clipping or false fill across the courtyard; steps, fine rails and lettering omitted.

original_pngs.name: courtyard-arcade
original_pngs.observation: Deliberate inner-court perspective verifies raised front corridor, thickened columns, open passage under it and northern upper screen/entry distinction. Court remains open and unfilled; pool, bridge, fine steps and landscaping are intentionally omitted.

source_basis.use: Attributed completed east and courtyard photographs, construction period 2014.10–2016.08; 2018.02 is publication date.
2015 PC construction grid and east elevation; structural axis sums and relative balcony/arcade locations. BIM images not treated as completion photographs.
School 1F full outline and courtyard/core topology; upper 2–9F images are only service-core excerpts, not full floor plans.
Journal issue 31: final scheme C site, standard floor and sections, excluding old A/B schemes. Post-completion design analysis, not measured as-built.
2017-09-17 photograph of completed east/front and north short side; northern rear portions still occluded.
School-attributed oblique facade photograph; visible north lower upper-screen/recessed entrance and long inclined glazing. Photograph date not independently assigned.
Official campus diagram page 17, north points right; building location only, not scale control.
Official PHOTO2 layer and surrounding tiles; approximate location/orientation and same-height high-frame roof-edge sanity check only, capture date unresolved.

accepted_evidence_limits: 2016 completed building exterior constrained by a 2017-09-17 built photograph; not a 2026 current-condition survey. 2018 landscape and 2020 interior alterations are not silently merged.
Only final scheme C supports core topology. A/B former schemes and construction BIM renderings are not substitutes for built evidence.

PC structural axis sum 81.90m and local C–G sum 20.30m are not outside-wall length or the whole low-wing/court/tower footprint. Orthophoto approx. 82.5m is a different same-level edge and only a plausibility check.

Published 45.4m height datum remains unresolved. Main roof about 40m, frame about 45m, front corridor/court dimensions, frame depth and thickness are estimated. The 4.8/4.4m rhythm is design-analysis data, not measured levels.
Right-handed output axes: +X approximately north, +Y approximately west, +Z up; east front is -Y. Source plan orientation and campus map rotation were reconciled, not mirrored.
South five sloping balcony fascias occupy relative 5–9F; north two occupy 5–6F plus the lowest low/plain 4F terrace. Exact small window divisions and hidden floor details are generalized.

West back windows/doors/equipment, tree-obscured southern details and rear part of the north short side are unknown and conservatively simplified. A blank model wall is not a claim the actual building lacks windows.

Raised front corridor retains real arcade openings across structural axes 3–7, open-to-sky court, continuous recessed inclined glazing and asymmetric northern upper-screen/lower-entry treatment. Southern low wing behind the front arcade remains a real boundary.

Fine rails and northern screen are thickened solid bands/plate; glazing is opaque recessed geometry, not a real transparent skin. Stairs, courtyard steps, signage, pool/bridge/roundabout landscape, hidden B1 and interiors are omitted or highly simplified.

Sloped-profile corners are rounded by 0.65mm and top-frame ends extend 0.5mm for solid joins at nominal 1:400. Visible rounded end joints are manufacturing simplifications, not surveyed facade fittings.
Undated rooftop PV/equipment are omitted from the 2017-constrained base exterior. Neutral procedural/solid colors clarify shape and do not reproduce every surface finish.
No source photographs, PDF pages, orthophotos or source comparison crops are included in this public-safe review or used as textures.

Supports are needed and no physical print was performed. Mesh integrity, arbitrary-direction thickness guarantees, support removal, drainage, stability and print success require separate assessment; this source GO does not approve them.

new_school_check.method: Fresh live GitHub main/commit reads at task start were unchanged; independently rehashed the fixed snapshot complete tree and rederived all package roots and institution identities. HDUT/Delin/Sihai and building aliases absent; Dahan explicitly separate.
